projects.description: AI-based network attack forecasting system using machine learning and network traffic analysis.
lines: # NexGuard
IMG0
### AI-based network attack forecasting system using machine learning and network traffic analysis.
NexGuard explores the application of machine learning in network security.
Built around CICIDS2018 traffic data, the project includes data
preprocessing, chunk-based dataset processing, Random Forest model training,
performance evaluation, verification across millions of network flows, and a
Flask-based prediction API.
Built with Python · Scikit-learn · Pandas · Flask · Machine Learning

projects.description: A Security Operations Center incident management platform focused on security workflows and incident handling.
lines: # SOCDesk
IMG0
### A Security Operations Center incident management platform focused on security workflows and incident handling.
SOCDesk is a security-focused application developed around SOC incident
management. The backend architecture uses Express.js, PostgreSQL, and Prisma
ORM, with structured database models, authentication, and API development.
The project is designed to explore how security operations platforms manage
incidents and organize security workflows.
Built with Node.js · Express.js · PostgreSQL · Prisma · JavaScript

projects.description: A hands-on SIEM lab exploring centralized security monitoring, log analysis, and threat detection using Wazuh.
lines: # SIEM Lab
### A hands-on SIEM lab exploring centralized security monitoring, log analysis, and threat detection using Wazuh.
An experimental security monitoring environment focused on understanding
SIEM architecture, endpoint monitoring, security event collection, and
centralized log analysis. Exploring Wazuh deployment, dashboard
configuration, agent communication, and security monitoring workflows in
Linux environments.
Built with Wazuh · Linux · SIEM · Log Analysis · VirtualBox

projects.description: A Flask-based API exposing a trained Random Forest model for network traffic classification and attack prediction.
lines: # Network Attack Prediction API
### A Flask-based API exposing a trained Random Forest model for network traffic classification and attack prediction.
A machine learning inference service built around a trained Random Forest
model. Uses Python and Joblib to load the serialized model and exposes
health-check and prediction endpoints through Flask. Designed to connect
network traffic analysis with an accessible prediction interface.
Built with Python · Flask · Joblib · REST API · Scikit-learn
